title: AnalyserOutput
description: Full output produced by the Analyser agent each turn. Contains the structural MILP model plus dialogue-tracking fields.

milp_model.description: Structural MILP model extracted so far. May be partial during early turns.

confirmed_assumptions.description: Assumptions the user has explicitly confirmed.

unconfirmed_assumptions.description: Assumptions the agent has made but the user has not yet confirmed. Each must have a corresponding entry in open_questions.

open_questions.description: Clarifying questions for the user. Empty means the agent is ready for final approval.

analysis_summary.description: Plain-English summary of the model for the user. No symbolic math or technical column names.

technical_summary.description: Technical summary including symbolic expressions and parameter names, for internal use and CodeGenerator context.
